entries.en: therefore; for this reason; on that account
because of you; for you
for that; because of that one

entries.zh: 因此；因这缘故（因只上＝因这上头）
entries.en: therefore; on this account; for it
entries.notes: M 栏两处声调号污损（T99），据 H「因只上」（只＝此）与西语 por ello 释义。

entries.en: to dispute with one another; to wrangle over words
entries.notes: M 栏多处[残]损，据 H「相諍」与西语 Porfiar（al/a la palabra，在言词上强争）拟释义。

entries.en: to quarrel; to wrangle
entries.notes: 声调号污损（T99）；词头「por fiar.」按本页 porfiar（强争）词族释义，据 H「争」。

entries.en: obstinate; to stick to one's own way in argument
entries.notes: H 首字有[疑:拘]，对音 âu 合于「拗」。

entries.zh: 争吵扭打；相斗一场（傷陣）
entries.en: to quarrel and scuffle; to come to blows in argument
entries.notes: M 栏声调号两处污损（T99），据 H「傷陣」与对音 sio-tin 释为争吵相斗。

entries.en: to provoke; to goad into argument

entries.zh: 相互刻毒相害；恶言相争（相刻賊）
entries.en: to treat each other harshly; to quarrel venomously
entries.notes: H「相刻賊」组合较僻，按 porfiar 语境释为相互刻毒争闹。

entries.en: to provoke resentment; to exasperate

entries.zh: 强嘴；嘴上死不认输（強口嘴）
entries.en: to argue stubbornly with the mouth; to insist against all argument
entries.notes: R 栏作 perible.，非官话对音样式，疑旁注或误读；据 L/H/M 三栏释义。

entries.zh: 逞口舌；逞嘴皮争胜（逞口嘴）
entries.en: to show off in words; to talk one's way to victory

entries.zh: 扮假做真；弄假成真（硬缠以求遂愿，如务求与少女成事）
entries.en: to play false and make it true; to insist so as to get one's way with the girl
to insist so as to keep up with (or outdo) the guide; to contend for the lead
to insist without reason; to quarrel groundlessly
entries.notes: H 首字有[疑:殿/拗]，对音 âu 合「拗」；sin racon 疑为 sin razón（无理）。

entries.zh: 倔强固执；无理强争到底（堅強）
entries.en: stubborn; obstinate; to persist without reason
entries.notes: H 次字有[疑:恣]，对音 kiáng 合「強」。

entries.zh: 硬碰硬；两个死硬派互不相让（硬拄硬）
entries.en: hard against hard; two obstinate wranglers, neither yielding
entries.notes: 中字声调号污损（T99）且「拄」有[疑:抵]，据对音 ngè-tu-ngè 与西语 porfiadores（两个死硬的强争者）释义。

entries.zh: 讼中狡辩；使诈争讼（狡詭）
entries.en: to plead craftily in a lawsuit; cunning wrangling

entries.zh: 讼争是非；计较是非曲直
entries.en: to dispute right and wrong in a lawsuit
entries.notes: 中字声调号污损（T99），H「較是非」与西语 pleito（官司）字义本身清晰。

entries.en: lawsuit; litigation; to go to law
entries.notes: 次字声调号污损（T99），H「詞訟」字义清晰。
